reasons: CS4220 requires CS2220 (or an equivalent bioinformatics prerequisite) which is not completed; CS2220 is added as the minimal prerequisite and is only offered in Sem 1, so it is placed in semester 7 and CS4220 in semester 8.
CS3237 is only offered in Sem 1, so it must be placed in semester 7.
CS3233 is offered in Sem 2 and is placed in semester 6 to spread the load as 4 MC, 8 MC, 4 MC across semesters 6-8.
CS3233 and CS3237 cannot be taken together because CS3233 is Sem 2 only and CS3237 is Sem 1 only.
CS4220 in semester 6 is not possible because its prerequisite cannot be completed in a strictly earlier semester before semester 6.
All semesters are within the 8 MC limit.
